entities.name: Isaac ibn Latif
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Isaac ibn Latif was a Jewish philosopher, who lived most of his life in Toledo. In 1238 he published
his first work, a treatise named sha'ar ha-shama'yim, a commentary on Koheles (Ecclesiastes). Artscroll's Koheles cites from his work.
